title: Cuiabá Tries to Escape Promotion Zone Against Ponte Preta
seoTitle: Cuiabá Tries to Escape Promotion Zone Against Ponte Preta
subtitle: Today's Match Could Seal Ponte Preta's Relegation and Shift Cuiabá's Promotion Battle
excerpt: With Ponte Preta at the bottom and needing points to avoid relegation, the clash against Cuiabá, which seeks to close the gap on promotion contenders.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the 30th round of Série B, Cuiabá hosts Ponte Preta at Arena Pantanal at 5 PM. The match could confirm Macaca's relegation and also influence the visiting team's promotion battle.

Relegation Risk for Ponte Preta

Sitting at the bottom of the competition with 13 points, Ponte Preta is 22 points behind the first club outside the relegation zone. Another setback, coupled with a victory by a direct rival, could make mathematical recovery impossible.

Ponte Preta's Point-Scoring Objective

The club aims to accumulate at least five points in the remaining eight rounds to avoid the worst Série B campaign in the history of the "points corridos" (round-robin) era. The minimum goal is to reach 18 points to avoid equaling Duque de Caxias' negative record of 17 points in 2011.

Ponte Preta's Absences and Internal Situations

Gilson Kleina faces problems in defining the lineup. Danilo Barcelos is serving a suspension for his third yellow card. Jota is out with a thigh injury, and André Lima, who might leave the club, is also unavailable. Murilo Cavalcante has already been released and intends to terminate his contract due to salary delays. Other players await definition for the substitutes' bench.

Cuiabá's Challenges

After a 3-0 defeat to CRB, coach Eduardo Barros attempts to react. The team occupies tenth position with 43 points, six points behind Atlético-GO, the last club that can still secure promotion. Cuiabá has scored 30 goals, a number only surpassed by América-MG.

Cuiabá's Absences

Marcelo Carné and Pepê remain in the medical department, while Vitor Mendes is serving a suspension for his third yellow card. Despite the absences, the squad includes players like João Carlos, João Basso, Igor Inocêncio, and forward Jean Dias.

Expectation for the Clash

With Ponte Preta on the verge of relegation and Cuiabá aiming to close the gap on promotion contenders, the clash gains prominence in the competition's final stretch. The result could define the immediate future of both teams.

With information from Correio.
